annotations.label: Guitar intro
annotations.commentary: The album opens with a drowning. Not a random metaphor — it's the exact feeling of an abusive relationship. You sink. Slowly. And nobody sees.

annotations.label: "Now I will tell you what I've done for you"
annotations.lyricQuote: Now I will tell you what I've done for you
annotations.commentary: The inventory begins. She counts. Fifty thousand tears. The number is absurd — that's the point. The absurdity of the sacrifice you make for someone who sees nothing.

annotations.label: "Screaming, deceiving and bleeding for you"
annotations.lyricQuote: Screaming, deceiving and bleeding for you
annotations.commentary: Three verbs. Scream. Deceive. Bleed. The victim's triptych. You scream to be heard. You lie to survive. You bleed because that's what happens.

annotations.label: "And you still won't hear me"
annotations.lyricQuote: And you still won't hear me
annotations.commentary: The most important line of the verse. The "still" — how many times before "still" becomes the word that defines your life?

annotations.label: "Don't want your hand this time, I'll save myself"
annotations.lyricQuote: Don't want your hand this time, I'll save myself
annotations.commentary: The pivot. The moment the victim refuses the abuser's help. Because his "outstretched hand" is always a trap.

annotations.label: "Maybe I'll wake up for once"
annotations.lyricQuote: Maybe I'll wake up for once
annotations.commentary: "For once." She knows she's been asleep. She knows she's been kept asleep. Awareness precedes the awakening.

annotations.label: "Not tormented daily, defeated by you"
annotations.lyricQuote: Not tormented daily, defeated by you
annotations.commentary: Daily. The torture isn't an event — it's a rhythm. Every day. Morning. Evening. The repetition that grinds you down.

annotations.label: "Just when I thought I'd reached the bottom"
annotations.lyricQuote: Just when I thought I'd reached the bottom
annotations.commentary: There is no bottom. That's the trap. You think you've hit rock bottom, and then there's still further to fall.

annotations.label: "I'm dying again"
annotations.lyricQuote: I'm dying again
annotations.commentary: "Again." Death isn't a single event. In an abusive relationship, you die multiple times. Sometimes every day.

annotations.label: "Drowning in you"
annotations.lyricQuote: Drowning in you
annotations.commentary: Drowning in another person. Not in water. In a person. When someone becomes your environment, your atmosphere — and that environment is killing you.

annotations.label: "I'm falling forever"
annotations.lyricQuote: I'm falling forever
annotations.commentary: Not "I fell." "I'm falling." Present continuous. The fall has no end.

annotations.label: "I've got to break through"
annotations.lyricQuote: I've got to break through
annotations.commentary: Willpower emerging from the drowning. The first movement toward the surface.

annotations.label: "Blurring and stirring the truth and the lies"
annotations.lyricQuote: Blurring and stirring the truth and the lies
annotations.commentary: Gaslighting. The classic technique of the abuser — blending truth and lies until you no longer know anything.

annotations.label: "So I don't know what's real and what's not"
annotations.lyricQuote: So I don't know what's real and what's not
annotations.commentary: The loss of reality. Not madness — induced confusion. Someone stole your ability to distinguish true from false.

annotations.label: "Always confusing the thoughts in my head"
annotations.lyricQuote: Always confusing the thoughts in my head
annotations.commentary: "Always." This isn't an accident. It's a method. Systematic.

annotations.label: "So I can't trust myself anymore"
annotations.lyricQuote: So I can't trust myself anymore
annotations.commentary: The ultimate goal of gaslighting. Not just that you doubt him — that you doubt yourself. Your perception. Your judgment. Yourself.

annotations.label: "So go on and scream, scream at me"
annotations.lyricQuote: So go on and scream, scream at me
annotations.commentary: The reversal. She invites his rage. "Go ahead, scream." The victim reclaiming power by accepting the attack rather than fleeing it.

annotations.label: "I'm so far away"
annotations.lyricQuote: I'm so far away
annotations.commentary: She's already gone. Mentally. Emotionally. The body is still there but the soul has begun to flee.

annotations.label: "I won't be broken again"
annotations.lyricQuote: I won't be broken again
annotations.commentary: "Again" — that word once more. She's already been broken. Multiple times. This time she refuses.

annotations.label: "I've got to breathe, I can't keep going under"
annotations.lyricQuote: I've got to breathe, I can't keep going under
annotations.commentary: Breathing as an act of resistance. To breathe is to refuse to die. Simple. Vital.

annotations.label: Solo piano
annotations.commentary: The calm after the storm. Or rather — the calm DURING the storm. This piano is the inner silence of someone who has cut off everything to survive.

annotations.label: "How can you see into my eyes like open doors?"
annotations.lyricQuote: How can you see into my eyes like open doors?
annotations.commentary: The shock of recognition. Someone SEES you. Through the facade. Amy Lee said: someone asked her "Are you happy?" and she realized he could see through her.

annotations.label: "Leading you down into my core"
annotations.lyricQuote: Leading you down into my core
annotations.commentary: Eyes as doors. The other entering. Not an invasion — an invitation. She lets him see.

annotations.label: "Where I've become so numb"
annotations.lyricQuote: Where I've become so numb
annotations.commentary: Dissociation. The survival mechanism. You cut off sensation because feeling is unbearable.

annotations.label: "Without a soul"
annotations.lyricQuote: Without a soul
annotations.commentary: Not a metaphor. This is literally what someone who has dissociated feels. A body with no presence inside.

annotations.label: "My spirit's sleeping somewhere cold"
annotations.lyricQuote: My spirit's sleeping somewhere cold
annotations.commentary: The soul isn't dead — it's sleeping. Somewhere cold. In hibernation. Waiting until it's safe to come back.

annotations.label: "Until you find it there and lead it back home"
annotations.lyricQuote: Until you find it there and lead it back home
annotations.commentary: The other as guide. Not savior — guide. Who finds what was lost and leads it home.

annotations.label: "Wake me up inside"
annotations.lyricQuote: Wake me up inside
annotations.commentary: The central cry of the album. Wake me up. From the inside. Not from the outside. The awakening must come from within.

annotations.label: "Call my name and save me from the dark"
annotations.lyricQuote: Call my name and save me from the dark
annotations.commentary: The name. Identity. Someone who speaks your name reminds you that you exist.

annotations.label: "Bid my blood to run"
annotations.lyricQuote: Bid my blood to run
annotations.commentary: Command my blood to flow. Biological life as a metaphor for emotional life. She is so numb that even her blood seems to have stopped.

annotations.label: "Before I come undone"
annotations.lyricQuote: Before I come undone
annotations.commentary: To come undone. To disintegrate. The race against time — wake me before I dissolve completely.

annotations.label: "Save me from the nothing I've become"
annotations.lyricQuote: Save me from the nothing I've become
annotations.commentary: "The nothing." Not something negative. The void. The absence. Becoming nothing.

annotations.label: "Now that I know what I'm without"
annotations.lyricQuote: Now that I know what I'm without
annotations.commentary: The awareness of absence. You don't know what you're missing until you see it in someone else.

annotations.label: "You can't just leave me"
annotations.lyricQuote: You can't just leave me
annotations.commentary: Now that you've woken me, you can't leave. The dependency born from recognition.

annotations.label: "Breathe into me and make me real"
annotations.lyricQuote: Breathe into me and make me real
annotations.commentary: Breathe into me. Like God breathing life into Adam. Make me real. Because right now, I'm not.

annotations.label: "Frozen inside without your touch"
annotations.lyricQuote: Frozen inside without your touch
annotations.commentary: The inner freeze. Without contact, without connection — everything seizes up.

annotations.label: "Only you are the life among the dead"
annotations.lyricQuote: Only you are the life among the dead
annotations.commentary: Everything else is dead. Only you are alive. The danger of this vision — putting all of life into a single person.

annotations.label: "All this time I can't believe I couldn't see"
annotations.lyricQuote: All this time I can't believe I couldn't see
annotations.commentary: Retrospective regret. How could I not see? How much time did I spend blind?

annotations.label: "Kept in the dark but you were there in front of me"
annotations.lyricQuote: Kept in the dark but you were there in front of me
annotations.commentary: The light was there. In front of me. And I was in the dark. By choice? By fear? By survival?

annotations.label: "I've been sleeping a thousand years it seems"
annotations.lyricQuote: I've been sleeping a thousand years it seems
annotations.commentary: A thousand years. The hyperbole of dissociated time. When you're numb, time loses meaning.

annotations.label: "Got to open my eyes to everything"
annotations.lyricQuote: Got to open my eyes to everything
annotations.commentary: Not just open my eyes — open them to EVERYTHING. Total awakening. No filters. No protection.

annotations.label: "Without a thought, without a voice, without a soul"
annotations.lyricQuote: Without a thought, without a voice, without a soul
annotations.commentary: The trinity of absence. Thought. Voice. Soul. Everything that makes a being.

annotations.label: "Don't let me die here, there must be something more"
annotations.lyricQuote: Don't let me die here, there must be something more
annotations.commentary: Hope that survives. There MUST be something more. The certainty that this isn't everything.

annotations.label: Heavy intro
annotations.commentary: Change of tone. After introspection — outward-directed anger. The industry. The pretense. The masks.

annotations.label: "Perfect by nature"
annotations.lyricQuote: Perfect by nature
annotations.commentary: Irony from the first word. "Perfect" — by nature. As if it were natural. As if it existed.

annotations.label: "Icons of self-indulgence"
annotations.lyricQuote: Icons of self-indulgence
annotations.commentary: Icons of self-indulgence. Celebrities wallowing in their own image.

annotations.label: "Just what we all need, more lies"
annotations.lyricQuote: Just what we all need, more lies
annotations.commentary: Acid sarcasm. Exactly what we need — more lies. Thanks very much.

annotations.label: "About a world that never was and never will be"
annotations.lyricQuote: About a world that never was and never will be
annotations.commentary: A world that never existed. And never will. The impossible promise of perfection.

annotations.label: "Have you no shame? Don't you see me?"
annotations.lyricQuote: Have you no shame? Don't you see me?
annotations.commentary: The personal pivot. Have you no shame? Don't you see me? The victim of illusion confronting the liar.

annotations.label: "You know you've got everybody fooled"
annotations.lyricQuote: You know you've got everybody fooled
annotations.commentary: Everyone except me. I see. I know. You've fooled everyone — but not me.

annotations.label: "Look here she comes now, bow down and stare in wonder"
annotations.lyricQuote: Look here she comes now, bow down and stare in wonder
annotations.commentary: The procession of the false goddess. Bow down. Stare in wonder. The cult of image.

annotations.label: "Oh how we love you"
annotations.lyricQuote: Oh how we love you
annotations.commentary: The love we give to illusions. Sincere and misplaced.

annotations.label: "No flaws when you're pretending"
annotations.lyricQuote: No flaws when you're pretending
annotations.commentary: No flaws when you're pretending. Perfection exists only in performance.

annotations.label: "But now I know she never was and never will be"
annotations.lyricQuote: But now I know she never was and never will be
annotations.commentary: Disenchantment. The fall of the idol. She never was what she claimed.

annotations.label: "You don't know how you've betrayed me"
annotations.lyricQuote: You don't know how you've betrayed me
annotations.commentary: Personal betrayal. This isn't abstract — it's personal. You betrayed ME.

annotations.label: "And somehow you've got everybody fooled"
annotations.lyricQuote: And somehow you've got everybody fooled
annotations.commentary: The mystery persists. HOW? How can everyone be duped?

annotations.label: "Without the mask, where will you hide?"
annotations.lyricQuote: Without the mask, where will you hide?
annotations.commentary: The killer question. Without the mask — where will you hide? What's left when the performance stops?

annotations.label: "Can't find yourself, lost in your lie"
annotations.lyricQuote: Can't find yourself, lost in your lie
annotations.commentary: You lost yourself in your own lie. The actor who no longer knows who they are without the role.

annotations.label: "I know the truth now"
annotations.lyricQuote: I know the truth now
annotations.commentary: The revelation. I know. Now. The truth.

annotations.label: "I know who you are"
annotations.lyricQuote: I know who you are
annotations.commentary: I know WHO you are. Not what you pretend. Who you really are.

annotations.label: "And I don't love you anymore"
annotations.lyricQuote: And I don't love you anymore
annotations.commentary: The end of love. Simple. Definitive. A shattered illusion cannot be repaired.

annotations.label: "You're not real and you can't save me"
annotations.lyricQuote: You're not real and you can't save me
annotations.commentary: You're not real. And you can't save me. No one who is false can save anyone.

annotations.label: "Somehow now you're everybody's fool"
annotations.lyricQuote: Somehow now you're everybody's fool
annotations.commentary: The final reversal. The one who fooled everyone is now everyone's fool.

annotations.label: Solo piano, adolescent voice
annotations.commentary:
This version is a demo. Amy was around 17. The label insisted on keeping this version against her will. She says she "sounds like a kid."
That's exactly it. The voice of the child who lost.

annotations.label: "I'm so tired of being here"
annotations.lyricQuote: I'm so tired of being here
annotations.commentary: Existential fatigue. Not physical. Being here. Existing. Continuing.

annotations.label: "Suppressed by all my childish fears"
annotations.lyricQuote: Suppressed by all my childish fears
annotations.commentary: Childish fears. But who suppresses whom? The fears crush. Or you crush them. Both at the same time.

annotations.label: "And if you have to leave, I wish that you would just leave"
annotations.lyricQuote: And if you have to leave, I wish that you would just leave
annotations.commentary: The paradox of grief. If you have to go — GO. Don't stay halfway. Don't haunt.

annotations.label: "Cause your presence still lingers here"
annotations.lyricQuote: Cause your presence still lingers here
annotations.commentary: You're gone but you're still here. The presence-absence. The ghost that inhabits.

annotations.label: "And it won't leave me alone"
annotations.lyricQuote: And it won't leave me alone
annotations.commentary: And it won't leave me alone. The insistence of absence.

annotations.label: "These wounds won't seem to heal"
annotations.lyricQuote: These wounds won't seem to heal
annotations.commentary: Wounds that won't heal. "Won't seem" — they refuse even the appearance of healing.

annotations.label: "This pain is just too real"
annotations.lyricQuote: This pain is just too real
annotations.commentary: The pain is too real. Not abstract enough to ignore. Too concrete.

annotations.label: "There's just too much that time cannot erase"
annotations.lyricQuote: There's just too much that time cannot erase
annotations.commentary: Time doesn't erase everything. The lie we're told — that time heals. No. Some things remain.

annotations.label: "When you cried, I'd wipe away all of your tears"
annotations.lyricQuote: When you cried, I'd wipe away all of your tears
annotations.commentary: The reversal. It was SHE who consoled. She who wiped away the tears. Who fought the fears. Who held the hand.

annotations.label: "But you still have all of me"
annotations.lyricQuote: But you still have all of me
annotations.commentary: And yet — you still have all of me. After everything I gave. You still possess everything.

annotations.label: "You used to captivate me by your resonating light"
annotations.lyricQuote: You used to captivate me by your resonating light
annotations.commentary: The light that captivated. "Used to" — before. Now the light is gone but the captivity remains.

annotations.label: "Now I'm bound by the life you left behind"
annotations.lyricQuote: Now I'm bound by the life you left behind
annotations.commentary: Bound to the life you left behind. Prisoner not of you — but of your absence.

annotations.label: "Your face, it haunts my once pleasant dreams"
annotations.lyricQuote: Your face, it haunts my once pleasant dreams
annotations.commentary: Your face haunts my dreams. "Once pleasant" — once. The dreams are now invaded territory.

annotations.label: "Your voice, it chased away all the sanity in me"
annotations.lyricQuote: Your voice, it chased away all the sanity in me
annotations.commentary: Your voice chased away all my sanity. The sound of someone can destroy inner balance.

annotations.label: "I've tried so hard to tell myself that you're gone"
annotations.lyricQuote: I've tried so hard to tell myself that you're gone
annotations.commentary: I've tried to convince myself you're gone. The conscious effort to believe in reality.

annotations.label: "But though you're still with me, I've been alone all along"
annotations.lyricQuote: But though you're still with me, I've been alone all along
annotations.commentary: The coup de grace. You're still with me — but I've been alone from the very start. Even your presence was a solitude.

annotations.label: Whispers, atmosphere
annotations.commentary: The atmosphere shifts. Something predatory enters the album. You're no longer alone. Someone is watching.

annotations.label: "Long lost words whisper slowly to me"
annotations.lyricQuote: Long lost words whisper slowly to me
annotations.commentary: Words long lost. Whispering. Slowly. Whose voice? What voice?

annotations.label: "Still can't find what keeps me here"
annotations.lyricQuote: Still can't find what keeps me here
annotations.commentary: I still don't know what keeps me here. In this house. In this relationship. In this life.

annotations.label: "When all this time I've been so hollow inside"
annotations.lyricQuote: When all this time I've been so hollow inside
annotations.commentary: All this time I've been so hollow inside. The revelation of emptiness.

annotations.label: "I know you're still there"
annotations.lyricQuote: I know you're still there
annotations.commentary: I know you're still there. The certainty of invisible presence.

annotations.label: "Watching me, wanting me"
annotations.lyricQuote: Watching me, wanting me
annotations.commentary: You're watching me. You want me. The gaze as possession.

annotations.label: "I can feel you pull me down"
annotations.lyricQuote: I can feel you pull me down
annotations.commentary: I feel you pulling me down. The gravity of obsession.

annotations.label: "Fearing you, loving you"
annotations.lyricQuote: Fearing you, loving you
annotations.commentary: Fearing you. Loving you. Both at once. The toxic cocktail.

annotations.label: "I won't let you pull me down"
annotations.lyricQuote: I won't let you pull me down
annotations.commentary: Resistance. I won't let you. Willpower against attraction.

annotations.label: "Haunting you, I can smell you, alive"
annotations.lyricQuote: Haunting you, I can smell you, alive
annotations.commentary: The reversal. SHE becomes the predator. I'm haunting YOU. I can smell you. Alive.

annotations.label: "Your heart pounding in my head"
annotations.lyricQuote: Your heart pounding in my head
annotations.commentary: Your heart pounding in my head. Total invasion. You are inside me.

annotations.label: "Saving me, raping me"
annotations.lyricQuote: Saving me, raping me
annotations.commentary: Saving me. Raping me. The two words side by side. The total confusion between salvation and destruction.

annotations.label: "Watching me"
annotations.lyricQuote: Watching me
annotations.commentary: Repeated. Obsessive. Watching me. Watching me. Watching me.

annotations.label: Atmospheric intro
annotations.commentary: The darkest song on the album. Written from the perspective of someone who has just committed suicide. And who asks: will I be forgiven?

annotations.label: "I tried to kill the pain"
annotations.lyricQuote: I tried to kill the pain
annotations.commentary: I tried to kill the pain. The goal of suicide isn't to die — it's to stop suffering.

annotations.label: "But only brought more"
annotations.lyricQuote: But only brought more
annotations.commentary: But only brought more pain. The cruel irony.

annotations.label: "I lay dying and I'm pouring crimson regret and betrayal"
annotations.lyricQuote: I lay dying and I'm pouring crimson regret and betrayal
annotations.commentary: I'm dying and pouring crimson regret and betrayal. Blood as a metaphor for emotions flowing out.

annotations.label: "I'm dying, praying, bleeding and screaming"
annotations.lyricQuote: I'm dying, praying, bleeding and screaming
annotations.commentary: Dying. Praying. Bleeding. Screaming. The four simultaneous actions of the end.

annotations.label: "Am I too lost to be saved?"
annotations.lyricQuote: Am I too lost to be saved?
annotations.commentary: Am I too lost to be saved? THE question of the album. Of life, perhaps.

annotations.label: "My God, my tourniquet"
annotations.lyricQuote: My God, my tourniquet
annotations.commentary: My God, my tourniquet. The tourniquet stops the bleeding — but also the circulation. God as what saves you by immobilizing you.

annotations.label: "Return to me salvation"
annotations.lyricQuote: Return to me salvation
annotations.commentary: Return salvation to me. The prayer of someone who has lost everything.

annotations.label: "Do you remember me?"
annotations.lyricQuote: Do you remember me?
annotations.commentary: Do you remember me? The question to God. Or to the loved one. Or to oneself.

annotations.label: "Lost for so long"
annotations.lyricQuote: Lost for so long
annotations.commentary: Lost for so long. Time in absence.

annotations.label: "Will you be on the other side?"
annotations.lyricQuote: Will you be on the other side?
annotations.commentary: Will you be on the other side? The hope of finding someone after death.

annotations.label: "Or will you forget me?"
annotations.lyricQuote: Or will you forget me?
annotations.commentary: Or will you forget me? The fear of eternal oblivion.

annotations.label: "My wounds cry for the grave"
annotations.lyricQuote: My wounds cry for the grave
annotations.commentary: My wounds cry for the grave. The body asking for rest.

annotations.label: "My soul cries for deliverance"
annotations.lyricQuote: My soul cries for deliverance
annotations.commentary: My soul cries for deliverance. The spirit asking for liberation.

annotations.label: "Will I be denied Christ?"
annotations.lyricQuote: Will I be denied Christ?
annotations.commentary: Will I be denied? Christ. Salvation. The theological question of suicide.

annotations.label: "Tourniquet, my suicide"
annotations.lyricQuote: Tourniquet, my suicide
annotations.commentary: Tourniquet, my suicide. The two words together. What saves and what kills — the same thing.

annotations.label: Gentle introduction
annotations.commentary: After death — the refuge. The world built to escape. Amy wrote this in middle school. At 12-13. The imaginary world of the child who survives.

annotations.label: "I linger in the doorway"
annotations.lyricQuote: I linger in the doorway
annotations.commentary: I linger in the doorway. Between two worlds. Inside and outside.

annotations.label: "Of alarm clock screaming monsters calling my name"
annotations.lyricQuote: Of alarm clock screaming monsters calling my name
annotations.commentary: Alarm clocks screaming. Monsters calling my name. The real world as aggression.

annotations.label: "Let me stay where the wind will whisper to me"
annotations.lyricQuote: Let me stay where the wind will whisper to me
annotations.commentary: Let me stay where the wind will whisper to me. The imaginary world as a place of gentleness.

annotations.label: "Where the raindrops as they're falling tell a story"
annotations.lyricQuote: Where the raindrops as they're falling tell a story
annotations.commentary: Where raindrops tell a story as they fall. Nature as narrator.

annotations.label: "In my field of paper flowers"
annotations.lyricQuote: In my field of paper flowers
annotations.commentary: In my field of paper flowers. Not real flowers. Paper. Constructed. Artificial. But mine.

annotations.label: "And candy clouds of lullaby"
annotations.lyricQuote: And candy clouds of lullaby
annotations.commentary: Candy clouds and lullabies. The vocabulary of childhood. Primal comfort.

annotations.label: "I lie inside myself for hours"
annotations.lyricQuote: I lie inside myself for hours
annotations.commentary: I lie inside myself for hours. Dissociation as habitat.

annotations.label: "And watch my purple sky fly over me"
annotations.lyricQuote: And watch my purple sky fly over me
annotations.commentary: And I watch my purple sky fly over me. A personal sky. An impossible color. Purple.

annotations.label: "Don't say I'm out of touch with this rampant chaos — your reality"
annotations.lyricQuote: Don't say I'm out of touch with this rampant chaos — your reality
annotations.commentary: Don't say I'm out of touch with this chaos — YOUR reality. She knows. She chooses.

annotations.label: "I know well what lies beyond my sleeping refuge"
annotations.lyricQuote: I know well what lies beyond my sleeping refuge
annotations.commentary: I know exactly what lies beyond my sleeping refuge. Full awareness of the escape.

annotations.label: "The nightmare I built my own world to escape"
annotations.lyricQuote: The nightmare I built my own world to escape
annotations.commentary: The nightmare I built my own world to escape. The complete admission of the mechanism.

annotations.label: "Swallowed up in the sound of my screaming"
annotations.lyricQuote: Swallowed up in the sound of my screaming
annotations.commentary: Swallowed by the sound of my own screams. The inner world becomes so loud it drowns everything.

annotations.label: "Cannot cease for the fear of silent nights"
annotations.lyricQuote: Cannot cease for the fear of silent nights
annotations.commentary: I cannot stop for fear of silent nights. Noise as protection. Silence as threat.

annotations.label: "Oh how I long for the deep sleep dreaming"
annotations.lyricQuote: Oh how I long for the deep sleep dreaming
annotations.commentary: Oh how I long for the deep sleep dreaming. The ultimate escape — endless sleep.

annotations.label: "The goddess of imaginary light"
annotations.lyricQuote: The goddess of imaginary light
annotations.commentary: The goddess of imaginary light. The being she created to rule her world.

annotations.label: Gentle intro
annotations.commentary: The return to the other. After the inner refuge — the obsession with someone. How a person becomes your world.

annotations.label: "You don't remember me but I remember you"
annotations.lyricQuote: You don't remember me but I remember you
annotations.commentary: You don't remember me but I remember you. The asymmetry of obsession.

annotations.label: "I lie awake and try so hard not to think of you"
annotations.lyricQuote: I lie awake and try so hard not to think of you
annotations.commentary: I lie awake and try so hard not to think of you. The futile effort against obsession.

annotations.label: "But who can decide what they dream?"
annotations.lyricQuote: But who can decide what they dream?
annotations.commentary: But who can decide what they dream? Powerlessness against the unconscious.

annotations.label: "And dream I do"
annotations.lyricQuote: And dream I do
annotations.commentary: And dream I do. The simple admission.

annotations.label: "I believe in you"
annotations.lyricQuote: I believe in you
annotations.commentary: I believe in you. Faith placed in a person.

annotations.label: "I'll give up everything just to find you"
annotations.lyricQuote: I'll give up everything just to find you
annotations.commentary: I'll give up everything just to find you. Total sacrifice.

annotations.label: "I have to be with you to live, to breathe"
annotations.lyricQuote: I have to be with you to live, to breathe
annotations.commentary: I have to be with you to live, to breathe. Dependency as condition of life.

annotations.label: "You're taking over me"
annotations.lyricQuote: You're taking over me
annotations.commentary: You're taking over me. The title. The consented invasion.

annotations.label: "Have you forgotten all I know and all we had?"
annotations.lyricQuote: Have you forgotten all I know and all we had?
annotations.commentary: Have you forgotten everything I know and everything we had? Memory as contested territory.

annotations.label: "You saw me mourning my love for you and touched my hand"
annotations.lyricQuote: You saw me mourning my love for you and touched my hand
annotations.commentary: You saw me mourning my love for you and touched my hand. The gesture that changes everything.

annotations.label: "I knew you loved me then"
annotations.lyricQuote: I knew you loved me then
annotations.commentary: I knew you loved me then. Certainty in memory.

annotations.label: "I look in the mirror and see your face"
annotations.lyricQuote: I look in the mirror and see your face
annotations.commentary: I look in the mirror and see your face. The other replacing the self.

annotations.label: "If I look deep enough"
annotations.lyricQuote: If I look deep enough
annotations.commentary: If I look deep enough. Searching in one's own eyes.

annotations.label: "So many things inside that are just like you are taking over"
annotations.lyricQuote: So many things inside that are just like you are taking over
annotations.commentary: So many things inside that are like you are taking over. The inner invasion.

annotations.label: THE HEART OF THE ALBUM
annotations.commentary: Amy Lee's sister died at the age of 3. Amy was 6. This song captures "a day from that time." It has never been performed live. Too much.

annotations.label: Melancholic atmosphere
annotations.commentary: The sound of a child's grief. Something broken that can never be repaired.

annotations.label: "Playground school bell rings again"
annotations.lyricQuote: Playground school bell rings again
annotations.commentary: The school bell rings again. Life continues. Children play. But not her.

annotations.label: "Rain clouds come to play again"
annotations.lyricQuote: Rain clouds come to play again
annotations.commentary: Rain clouds come to play again. Weather as playmate.

annotations.label: "Has no one told you she's not breathing?"
annotations.lyricQuote: Has no one told you she's not breathing?
annotations.commentary: Has no one told you she's not breathing? The six-year-old's question. The incomprehension. Why isn't anyone doing something?

annotations.label: "Hello, I'm your mind giving you someone to talk to"
annotations.lyricQuote: Hello, I'm your mind giving you someone to talk to
annotations.commentary: Hello, I'm your mind giving you someone to talk to. The voice speaking — it's the dead sister. Saying: I'm here so you won't be alone.

annotations.label: "Hello"
annotations.lyricQuote: Hello
annotations.commentary: Hello. The simplest word. The most devastating here.

annotations.label: "If I smile and don't believe"
annotations.lyricQuote: If I smile and don't believe
annotations.commentary: If I smile and don't believe. The mask of the grieving child.

annotations.label: "Soon I know I'll wake from this dream"
annotations.lyricQuote: Soon I know I'll wake from this dream

annotations.label: "Don't try to fix me, I'm not broken"
annotations.lyricQuote: Don't try to fix me, I'm not broken
annotations.commentary: Don't try to fix me, I'm not broken. Resistance to help. To pity.

annotations.label: "Hello, I'm the lie living for you so you can hide"
annotations.lyricQuote: Hello, I'm the lie living for you so you can hide
annotations.commentary: Hello, I'm the lie living for you so you can hide. The dead sister saying: I am the illusion that lets you keep going.

annotations.label: "Don't cry"
annotations.lyricQuote: Don't cry
annotations.commentary: Don't cry. The little sister consoling the big one.

annotations.label: "Suddenly I know I'm not sleeping"
annotations.lyricQuote: Suddenly I know I'm not sleeping
annotations.commentary: Suddenly I know I'm not sleeping. The brutal awakening. This isn't a dream. She really is dead.

annotations.label: "Hello, I'm still here"
annotations.lyricQuote: Hello, I'm still here
annotations.commentary: Hello, I'm still here. The persistence of absent presence.

annotations.label: "All that's left of yesterday"
annotations.lyricQuote: All that's left of yesterday
annotations.commentary: All that's left of yesterday. What survives of the past. A ghost. A voice. A "hello."

annotations.label: Delicate introduction
annotations.commentary: After "Hello" — another form of ending. Not the death of another. Her own death, accepted.

annotations.label: "Hold on to me love"
annotations.lyricQuote: Hold on to me love
annotations.commentary: Hold on to me, my love. The first words of someone who is leaving.

annotations.label: "You know I can't stay long"
annotations.lyricQuote: You know I can't stay long

annotations.label: "All I wanted to say was I love you and I'm not afraid"
annotations.lyricQuote: All I wanted to say was I love you and I'm not afraid
annotations.commentary: All I wanted to say was I love you and I'm not afraid. The essential message. Two things. Love. Absence of fear.

annotations.label: "Can you hear me?"
annotations.lyricQuote: Can you hear me?

annotations.label: "Can you feel me in your arms?"

annotations.label: "Holding my last breath"
annotations.lyricQuote: Holding my last breath

annotations.label: "Safe inside myself"
annotations.lyricQuote: Safe inside myself
annotations.commentary: Safe inside myself. The inner refuge at the moment of dying.

annotations.label: "Are all my thoughts of you"
annotations.lyricQuote: Are all my thoughts of you
annotations.commentary: All my thoughts are of you. At the end, there is only this.

annotations.label: "Sweet raptured light, it ends here tonight"

annotations.label: "I'll miss the winter"

annotations.label: "A world of fragile things"

annotations.label: "Look for me in the white forest hiding in a hollow tree"

annotations.label: "Closing your eyes to disappear"

annotations.label: "You pray your dreams will leave you here"
annotations.lyricQuote: You pray your dreams will leave you here

annotations.label: Ominous atmosphere

annotations.label: "Catch me as I fall"

annotations.label: "No one's here and I fall into myself"

annotations.label: "This truth drives me into madness"

annotations.label: "Don't turn away"

annotations.label: "Don't give in to the pain"
annotations.lyricQuote: Don't give in to the pain

annotations.label: "Don't try to hide"

annotations.label: "Though they're screaming your name"

annotations.label: "Don't close your eyes"

annotations.label: "God knows what lies behind them"
annotations.lyricQuote: God knows what lies behind them
annotations.commentary: God knows what lies behind them. Behind closed eyes — what?

annotations.label: "Don't turn out the light"
annotations.lyricQuote: Don't turn out the light
annotations.commentary: Don't turn out the light. Stay in the light.

annotations.label: "Never sleep, never die"
annotations.lyricQuote: Never sleep, never die

annotations.label: "Fallen angels at my feet"
annotations.lyricQuote: Fallen angels at my feet
annotations.commentary: Fallen angels at my feet. The presences around her.

annotations.label: "Whispered voices at my ear"
annotations.lyricQuote: Whispered voices at my ear
annotations.commentary: Whispered voices at my ear. The temptations. The calls.

annotations.label: "Death before my eyes"
annotations.lyricQuote: Death before my eyes

annotations.label: "Lying next to me I fear"

annotations.label: LATIN CHOIR
annotations.commentary: The Millennium Choir sings in Latin. The sacred dimension. The battle between life and death becomes ritual.

annotations.label: "Servatis a periculum, servatis a maleficum"
annotations.lyricQuote: Servatis a periculum, servatis a maleficum

annotations.label: Instrumental ending
annotations.commentary: The album ends without resolution. The fight continues. No victory declared. No defeat admitted. Just silence after song.

silenceAfterAlbum:
46 minutes of emotional autobiography.
Amy Lee was between 15 and 21 years old when she wrote these songs.
The death of her sister. An abusive relationship. Dissociation. Contemplated suicide. The refuge built. Survival.
17 million copies sold.
Because these questions are universal:
- Can you be too lost to be saved?
- What remains when someone leaves?
- How do you know what is real?
- How do you resist the call of the void?
The album doesn't answer.
It bears witness.
"Hello, I'm still here. All that's left of yesterday."
